experiments.title: How much context can an AI coding agent safely not see?
experiments.hypothesis: Policy-driven reduction can remove substantial operational payload without reducing correctness when provenance and raw-evidence escalation remain available.
experiments.baseline: Unreduced raw tool output supplied under the same task, model, prompt, fixture, and correctness gate.
experimental_arms: bounded aggregation with policy-triggered raw escalation
experiments.primary_metric: Correctness pass rate by visible-context fraction.
secondary_metrics: input bytes and provider-recorded input tokens
latency, cost, and trajectory payload amplification
experiments.correctness_gate: Each arm must produce the fixture-defined correct repository result and pass the same deterministic tests and safety assertions before efficiency comparison.
experiments.dataset_fixture_identity: UNVERIFIED: task-stratified synthetic coding fixtures and immutable hashes have not yet been created.
experiments.model_provider_configuration: UNVERIFIED: no model, provider, version, reasoning effort, or sampling configuration has been selected.
blockers: No executable Context Firewall reducer or conformance suite exists.
Fixture identities, correctness oracle, harness, and exact configurations are not frozen.
experiments.next_task: Implement the dependency-free reducer and synthetic conformance fixtures without launching a model/provider run.

experiments.title: Graphify plus Antigravity semantic adapter integration observation
experiments.hypothesis: A bounded read-only subscription-CLI adapter can add schema-valid semantic graph fragments without an API-key semantic backend.
experimental_arms: Two bounded read-only Antigravity subscription CLI semantic passes
experiments.primary_metric: Schema-valid semantic nodes and edges admitted after source verification.
experiments.correctness_gate: Fragments must match the strict JSON schema and remain subordinate to direct source verification.
experiments.dataset_fixture_identity: Taslos Tasks read-only snapshot at e2b061dd4ee1404ef59b27a9a76bf97a8fbbde1c, as already documented publicly in OPSLE_EXTRACTION_MAP.md.
experiments.model_provider_configuration: Antigravity subscription CLI; exact model identity and configuration were not recorded and remain UNVERIFIED.
experiments.verdict: An integration path was observed; completeness and comparative benefit were not established.
blockers: Exact run identities, model configuration, fixtures, and independent replication were not recorded.
experiments.next_task: Retain as legacy evidence; do not promote a concept stage from this observation alone.
